title: An agent finds the deterministic tool that answers a question from one entry point, instead of reading files
goal: python3 _tools/kbtools.py, the kb_tools MCP tool and one AGENTS.md line give an agent the catalog of the kb's tools (each _tools command-line tool, skill, agent and kb MCP tool) and, for a need in plain words, the few that answer it with their command lines, read from structured lines in each tool's docstring and the existing frontmatter and tool descriptions; kb_ask.py routes a which-tool question there; a tool without those lines fails the docs check
notes: Decided at planning (operator asked for a decision): a command plus an MCP tool fed by structured docstring lines, not a skill, since a skill loads text the model must reason over, the cost this avoids; skills and agents enter the catalog by their existing frontmatter descriptions. The coordination settings explainer of EP-nij36lt7 (ST-vopsopkg, kbsettings.py explain and kb_settings) is one catalog entry.
